name: open-evora
description: Root developer commands. tools/*.js (the current behavioural baseline) stays dependency-free; tools/research/ (TC-01 core foundation) is TypeScript with a minimal, justified dependency surface (yaml + TypeScript typechecking). The Research Explorer app (apps/research-explorer/) owns its own separate dependencies.

scripts.explorer: npm run build-data --prefix apps/research-explorer && npm run dev --prefix apps/research-explorer
scripts.explorer:build: npm run build-data --prefix apps/research-explorer && npm run typecheck --prefix apps/research-explorer && npm run test --prefix apps/research-explorer && npm run build --prefix apps/research-explorer
